name: Charter Medical LLC
old_description: We deliver scalable, single-use solutions designed for your advanced processes. Built to help you make the impossible, possible.
about:
Charter Medical LLC operates from Winston-Salem, North Carolina. The company has nearly 35 years of experience developing single-use products for life sciences, though a founding year is not disclosed. It operates as part of the Solesis family of companies alongside sister firms Polyzen, Secant Group, and SanaVita Medical.

The company designs and manufactures scalable single-use solutions including bio-containers, fluid transfer sets, bags, filters, and manifolds for bioprocessing, blood management, cell and gene therapy, and cryopreservation. Its 16,000-square-foot cleanroom facility in Winston-Salem is ISO 13485-certified and FDA-registered, supporting custom product design and manufacturing from prototype to commercial scale.

Charter Medical serves the cell therapy, blood transfusion, biotechnology, and pharmaceutical markets. Its customers include biopharmaceutical innovators developing advanced therapies who require customizable single-use systems for upstream and downstream processing, fluid transfer, filtration, and cold-chain storage.

The company emphasizes proven customization capabilities, an innovation roadmap in design and biomaterials, and a commitment to responsiveness and collaboration to reduce cost and risk in delivering advanced therapies. Integrated R&D with Solesis sister companies further supports technology development.
